heading: Build a hosted remote MCP server so a web chat client can use the same Git-backed desk as local sessions

events.explanation: The main session opened the task: it surveyed the existing desk server and hosting options, wrote a spec and plan checked by adversarial reviewers, then built, reviewed, merged and deployed the hosted gateway.
A short headless self-test session ran the hosted acceptance checklist against a throwaway desk before the reworked version was released.

The first delivery was recorded near the end of the main session's first share segment, after an earlier version had been sent back and reworked so that live acceptance checks in the web chat client passed.
After delivery, a reused chat was found to miss the desk instructions. Work resumed to send them on every status call and to fix a skill-description display bug, each verified live.
The task was re-delivered and marked done with all four steps delivered. It was delivered without a recorded sign-off. The re-delivery falls inside the second share segment, not at its end.
